workflows.name: Python bug fix verified by unittest
workflows.description: Stdlib-only Python bug fixes confined to an explicit file allowlist, verified by allowlisted unittest commands, and held at a human review gate before delivery.
workflows.rollback_strategy: Originals are backed up under runs/<task>/backup before delivery. Rollback restores them and refuses if the source changed after delivery.
